items.title: Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
items.summary: The home secretary laid out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency.

items.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
items.summary: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

items.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
items.summary: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

items.title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
items.summary: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

items.title: PM plans debt re-set for Commonwealth nations as slavery apology talks begin
items.summary: The move comes as the prime minister begins talks about the UK issuing a formal apology for the slave trade in the next year.

items.title: Jewellery sold as sterling silver on Amazon and Temu found to contain toxic chemicals
items.summary: An investigation by Watchdog analysed 25 items bought from Amazon, Etsy, Temu, eBay and OnBuy.

items.title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
items.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.

items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.summary: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.
